title: The Foreign coin on the table
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：foreign　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 foreign 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the doctor wrote of ① a foreign coin on the table in the chart, and everybody in the clinic said at once that it was ② so foreign that nobody in the clinic would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the doctor, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the foreign ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the foreign coin on the table that anybody there had ever seen, or so the chart for January 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too foreign to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the patient who had come to help; the foreign ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bandage at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a foreign accent of the visitor, and said that no patient in his right mind would call it ⑥ as foreign as the accent of the visitor they had once had in the old clinic. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was foreign or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the chart. What the line asked for was ⑦ something foreign, and nothing besides. The patient from the next clinic called the whole plan ⑧ quite foreign; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the chart kept the names of the foreign ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, twice over, she wrote of another foreign coin on the table in the same chart, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less foreign than anybody had expected. ⑩ The foreign accent of the visitor that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the foreign ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 外国（前置定语 a foreign coin on the table：1970 年大夫在病历里记下的那件外国的外币）
B. adj. 外国／异乡（两处加强说法：so foreign that … 与 no less foreign than …）
C. adj. 外国／异乡（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 外国（表语 too foreign to do：母亲觉得它太外国，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 异乡（前置定语 a foreign accent of the visitor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩异乡的口音）
F. adj. 异乡（同级比较 as foreign as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩来客的异乡口音相比）
G. adj. 异乡（后置定语 something foreign：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 异乡（受程度副词修饰 quite foreign：那位病人的评价）

items.q: a foreign coin on the table
the foreign coin on the table that
a foreign accent of the visitor
The foreign accent of the visitor that

answers.why: foreign 意为“外国”，1970 年大夫在病历里记下的是“一件外国的外币”，此处作前置定语 a foreign coin on the table。
foreign 意为“外国”，此处用 so foreign that 结构，说它外国到卫生所里没人敢靠近。
foreign 意为“外国”，病历上 一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的外国桌上的外币，等于最高级的说法。
foreign 意为“外国”，母亲认为这件东西“太外国了，谁也用不上”，too foreign to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
foreign 意为“异乡”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩异乡的口音”，此处作前置定语 a foreign accent of the visitor。
foreign 意为“异乡”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩来客的异乡口音一样异乡”，同级比较用 as foreign as。
foreign 意为“异乡”，病历上那半行字要的是“异乡的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something foreign。
foreign 意为“异乡”，邻卫生所来的那位病人认为这套计划“相当异乡”，quite 修饰原级 foreign。
foreign 意为“异乡”，no less foreign than 表示“其异乡不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之异乡不亚于任何人的预料。
foreign 意为“异乡”，母亲 1982 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的异乡口音”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，大夫在病历里记下了一件外国的外币。（a foreign coin on the table）
它外国到卫生所里没有一个人敢靠近。（so foreign that …）
母亲觉得它太外国，谁也用不上。（too foreign to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩异乡的口音。（a foreign accent of the visitor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩来客的异乡口音一样异乡。（as foreign as …）
到了 1977 年，病历上只剩半行字：要的是一件异乡的东西。（something foreign）
answers: In 1970 the doctor wrote of a foreign coin on the table in the chart.
It was so foreign that nobody in the clinic would go near it.
My mother thought it too foreign to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a foreign accent of the visitor.
He said nobody would call it as foreign as the accent of the visitor they had once had.
By 1977 the chart asked for nothing but something foreign.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 foreign 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the doctor wrote of a foreign coin on the table in the chart, and nobody forgot it.
It was the foreign coin on the table that anybody there had ever seen, or so the chart says.
My mother thought it too foreign to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a foreign accent of the visitor, and nobody argued with him.
The patient from the next clinic called the plan quite foreign, and everybody laughed.
The foreign ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
